Part 1 — Financial Planning, Performance and
Analytics. Six domains.

External Financial Reporting Decisions 15% ·
Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting 20% ·
Performance Management 20%

Cost Management 15% · Internal Controls 15% ·
Technology and Analytics 15%

Part 1 is the engine room: how the numbers are
built, budgeted, measured and controlled.

Part 2 — Strategic Financial Management. Six
domains.

Financial Statement Analysis 20% · Corporate
Finance 20% · Decision Analysis 25%

Risk Management 10% · Investment Decisions 10%
· Professional Ethics 15%

Part 2 is the boardroom: what the numbers
mean, and what you decide because of them.

Each part: 4 hours. 100 multiple-choice
questions in 3 hours — 75% of the score.

Then 1 hour: from the September 2026 window,
two case-based questions replace the essays.

At least 50% on the multiple choice unlocks
the second section. Pass mark: 360 of 500.

Three windows a year: Jan–Feb · May–Jun ·
Sep–Oct

To be certified: IMA membership · a bachelor's
degree or approved certification · 2 years'
relevant experience

The experience can be completed up to 7 years
after passing — so you can sit the exam first.
